ev.q: For males, the age-adjusted COPD death rate in rural counties was 59% higher than in large central metropolitan counties
COPD death rates for males were 21% to 47% higher than for females
Sources: National Vital Statistics System. County-level mortality file.
Counties were classified into urbanization levels based on a classification scheme that considers metropolitan/nonmetropolitan status, population, and other factors.
